description: This file defines an interface for a consistency test grain and a custom exception related to user aborts, within the Orleans framework. It includes method signatures for running consistency tests with options, and serialization attributes for the exception class.

classes.name: UserAbort
classes.description: A serializable exception thrown when a user aborts a transaction.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Asynchronous method to execute a consistency test with specified options, depth, stack trace, maximum attempts, and a stop time.
